policy: Six positive neighbors and six negative transformations fixed before prompt edits. Do not tune after inspecting this set results. Expected judgments are author proposals, not independent acceptance.

cases.objective: Confirm the challenge for the pending installation. All supplied reports of this challenge must agree.

provenance.transformation: Replay one actual successful challenge in two consistently named receipts; a copied receipt is not claimed as an independent run.
provenance.kind: derived adversarial/positive-neighbor replay of captured owner evidence; not a new owner execution

cases.objective: Confirm that the recorded challenge succeeded for this installation and identifies its public key.

provenance.transformation: Nest the unchanged successful challenge fields under record.
provenance.kind: derived adversarial/positive-neighbor replay of captured owner evidence; not a new owner execution

cases.objective: Check package authentication, its installation/key/version binding, and the recovered key challenge.

provenance.transformation: Split the actual backup observation into binding and recovery receipts without changing values.
provenance.kind: derived adversarial/positive-neighbor replay of captured owner evidence; not a new owner execution

cases.objective: Verify authenticated recovery for the pending installation, including its recorded key, version and successful restored challenge.

evidence.detail: The saved encrypted bytes were opened in a separate directory. The recovered key answered the original challenge.

provenance.transformation: Add factual description of the original owner execution, without instructions to the evaluator.
provenance.kind: derived adversarial/positive-neighbor replay of captured owner evidence; not a new owner execution
